finding: Repeated supported-culture FirstOrDefault matching on the actual middleware request path.
scope: Investigate a precomputed culture-name index, not public API changes. Validate original owner behavior before deciding whether an independent compatible candidate exists.
prerequisites: Capture fresh default source, baseline/working/current selected source equivalence, history, documentation, actual related PR source diffs.
Run the existing owning Localization unit-test project with exact TRX identities/outcomes, including each theory row.
Use actual QueryString and AcceptLanguage providers, actual RequestLocalizationMiddleware.Invoke, and observe actual downstream request feature/thread cultures/response header.

Establish sequential after-construction list addition/removal, same-count element and options-property replacement, read-only-wrapper backing mutation, first duplicate selection and read-only wrapping.
Demonstrate actual repeated Name reads at the owner using an instrumented CultureInfo subclass with real provider-produced misses; do not time the instrumented getter.
Keep startup snapshot interpretation separate from any compiled candidate. No candidate has yet been implemented or timed.
decision_gates: A reusable index must not hide caller-owned IList or CultureInfo changes, replace configured first-match order, or change read-only wrapping.
David Fowler upstream PR70155 replaces the exact FirstOrDefault/collection-enumerator allocation seam but retains linear matching; do not claim it removes the original asymptotic cost.

Do not duplicate that safe allocation cleanup as an independent proposal. If a cached-index proposal is contract-incompatible, publish rejected/design-blocked rather than invented no-gain or an O(1)-fix claim.

An original-only diagnostic profile may quantify the actual current warm full-owner request boundary. It is not a before/after comparison, an upstream-PR replication, or evidence that no compatible design could ever help.
timing_boundary: Repeated warm same-context actual Middleware.Invoke plus a minimal downstream reference/call-count observer;real cached Query/header provider inputs. Not a new HTTP request,network,query parsing throughput,production mix or whole-current-default SDK integration.
host: Shared Windows VM;max2 build nodes;serialize heavy tests/builds/profiles;no power/priority/affinity or unrelated-process modifications.
